executor_notes: PREMISE STALE — the P0 bug is ALREADY FIXED in the tree; the planned high-risk repair was deliberately NOT implemented. Per the controller's 'RE-VERIFY the ImportedADTChain failure mechanism before M2; if the mechanism differs, adapt to observed reality' directive, all 3 parked tests were un-skipped and OBSERVED to PASS on the pristine worktree (HEAD 800f0ec90) with NO code changes. The design-doc bug (imported-ADT return type erased to a type var -> silent acceptance) no longer reproduces: `decode(jo([]))`, `needsString(jo([]))`, and local `wrap()->Result used as string` all now emit the correct compile-time type error, verified via the built binary AND deterministically at -count=20. The full interface serialise->deserialise roundtrip (an EXPORTED Result-returning func misused as string in a THIRD downstream module) is also caught. The hole was closed by two fixes that POSTDATE the design doc, both ancestors of HEAD: M-TVAR-COLLISION-FIX (e67e24cb1, persistent inferFreshCounter) and M-TYPE-LIST-SOUND round 4 (9fbcb9173, baseEnvFreeVars generalization-withholding). The doc's literal root cause (InferWithConstraints never applies the solve sub to updatedEnv, typechecker_core.go:492) technically still holds, but the generalization site no longer emits the offending forall-a scheme, so there is no observable soundness loss to repair. Implementing the planned alpha-rename-on-every-scheme-insertion + post-solve repair (both in the high-risk shared internal/types infra the plan itself rates 'High risk-per-LOC') would add pure downside risk to fix a nonexistent bug -> violates scope discipline, the North Star (minimal frozen core), and AUDIT-BEFORE-PATCHING. DELIVERED INSTEAD: un-skipped the 3 tests (permanent regression guards) + added TestTypeSafety_CrossModule_ExportedADTRoundtrip (guards the interface-builder path the 3 originals miss) + full gates green. RECOMMENDATION to controller: mark the M-TYPEENV-SUB backlog item RESOLVED (fixed by adjacent list-soundness/tvar-collision work, now regression-guarded); the defensive alpha-rename/Meta-Quant-split machinery, if still wanted, is a SEPARATE robustness decision — not this P0 fix.
